name: Xceed ~Chou Nou Ren'ai~
source:
You lived the normal life of a high school student.
You have always had a strange dream—is it of a past memory you’ve forgotten or something entirely different?
One weekend you go on a club trip with members of the Super Science Club you are a member of.
There some strange phenomenon happens to your childhood friend, Haruma Motoki, which is followed by the appearance of an unidentified detective and a strange researcher.
The wheel of fate spun by your forgotten memories has begun to turn once more.

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.scichickkaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你過著普通高中生的生活。
你一直做著一個奇怪的夢——那是被你遺忘的過去記憶，還是完全不同的什麼東西？
某個週末，你與超科學社的成員一起參加社團旅行。旅途中，你的青梅竹馬元木春馬身上發生了奇怪的現象，隨後一名身分不明的偵探和一位古怪的研究員出現了。
你遺忘的記憶，再次推動了命運之輪。

（來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.scichickkaigai]Google Play[/url]）
